text: Guessed K4 texts (drafts) as extra knowledge: a score that rewards their four-letter pieces should pull a search towards Sanborn-like prose.
24 drafts written by another model, never in the score, hidden as plants; found if above all 12 shuffled copies searched with the same score.
Found: English 18, half drafts 16, a fifth drafts 12 of 24; letters right 36.8, 37.9, 37.2 of 97 on average.
